pages.title: Parties
pages.text: When playing multiplayer, you can create or join a party with friends. While in the same party, your spells will not damage your teammates.$(br2)Commands for party management:$(br)$(list)Create party:$(br)  $(copy:/oparties create)/oparties create$()$(br)$(list)Disband party:$(br)  $(copy:/oparties destroy confirm)/oparties destroy $(br)   confirm$()

$(list)Leave party:$(br)  $(copy:/oparties leave)/oparties leave$()$(br)$(list)Invite player:$(br)  $(copy:/oparties member invite )/oparties member $(br)   invite <player id>$()$(br)$(list)Kick player:$(br)  $(copy:/oparties member kick )/oparties member $(br)   kick <player id>$()$(br)$(list)Join party:$(br)  $(copy:/oparties join )/oparties join <id>$()
